subject: Replace 2x vpxor with vpternlogd in avx512 scramble
change_summary: Replaces two AVX512 XORs with ternary logic in scramble.

units.name: Replaces two AVX512 XORs with ternary logic in scramble.
units.evidence: All five fixed 256/320-byte public XXH3 AVX512 hash targets prove bidirectionally; their old/new optimized LLVM IR is byte-identical. Raw arbitrary accumulator scramble remains inconclusive.

notes: The verdict covers only the indicated targets and configurations; inconclusive cases are not counted as equivalence.
